description: The House Committee on Education and Labor (Democratic staff) seeks a Director of Labor Oversight to manage oversight and investigations on the Labor team. Please submit all materials to E&L.Jobs@mail.house.gov with "Director of Labor Oversight" in the subject line. The salary range is $95K - $115K, commensurate with education and experience. Candidates of diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.
